reserveReview.rationale: The issuer snapshot explicitly published 30 August 2026 reports USDQ reserves at 33% cash and 66% government bonds, with 101.91% reserve coverage. Dollar reserve policy identifies US Treasuries. The named percentages sum to 99%; retain the unexplained 1% as a measured unclassified tail without normalizing the named categories. The publication date is the only dated basis disclosed, not an independent attestation or an assertion of a later measured book.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Whole USDQ reserve denominator in the issuer snapshot published 30 August 2026: 33% cash + 66% government bonds + 1% unexplained residual
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The issuer does not classify the missing percentage point, name its deposit banks, give a maximum maturity, or quantify bond realization time. The 1% tail remains unclassified.
